purpose: Bounded FINAL PUBLIC EXPERIENCE v1 typography and editorial pass: unify the public system-font hierarchy across home, linked pages, header, login, Gekta chat and contact dock; retire visible microtype; keep mobile body/supporting copy readable; and rewrite public RU/EN/ZH copy to be concise, natural and free of repetitive machine-like phrasing while preserving server-authoritative product truth.
requiredInvariants: Use one local system sans-serif stack across the canonical public experience; no runtime font CDN or paid font dependency.
Visible public microcopy is >=12 CSS px; semantic supporting copy is >=14 CSS px on handheld layouts; body/lead copy uses a readable 15-16px scale.
Public headings use a consistent fluid hierarchy and do not jump between serif and sans-serif families.
Header, navigation, login, Gekta assistant, contact dock, home and linked pages share the same typography family and proportional hierarchy.
Existing >=44px target, zero horizontal overflow, CLS <=0.1, Axe, Lighthouse, RU/EN/ZH, security and browser thresholds are unchanged.

Editorial changes preserve server-authoritative semantics: no client-selected role/tenant, no invented live data, no invented integration or financial state, no claim of external confirmation without evidence.
Public copy removes repetitive machine-like phrasing, unnecessary jargon, English technical leakage in RU/ZH, and promotional filler without weakening factual precision.
No apps/api, Prisma, domain-core, auth, RBAC/RLS, tenant, Deal state machine, money, outbox, infrastructure, workflow or production release semantics are changed.
acceptance: Exact-head web unit/typecheck/build and source-controlled scope guard pass.
Canonical visual acceptance is reviewed for the intended typography/copy change without increasing perceptual maxDistance thresholds.
Design System v8 browser/accessibility matrix passes with CLS <=0.1 and existing Axe/browser thresholds unchanged.
Strategic Home Lighthouse retains the existing mobile and desktop thresholds.
Mobile 320/375/390/430 renders readable text, >=44px interactive targets and zero page-level horizontal overflow.
RU/EN/ZH public home and linked pages contain natural, idiomatic copy with no English implementation-status tokens leaking into RU/ZH user-facing text.
Gekta assistant, public header, contact dock and login use the same local system-font stack and no visible text below 12px.
No production/FROZEN claim is made from this branch until merged exact main is separately released and accepted on REG.RU.
